image_prompt: A detailed macro photorealistic photograph of Rama Lama, the handcrafted plush bighorn sheep with soft curly brown fleece, thick backward-curving cream fleece horns, dark bead eyes, plush brown hooves, and a single round turquoise bead on a cord necklace. caption: Rama Lama unrolling the narrative way-marker scroll across the cherrywood table, mapping the four dramatic movements of the midnight ride.
